title: Introduce yourself
goal: Say your name, where you are from, where you live and what you do.
scenario: You just met the learner at a language exchange (intercambio) in a café in Madrid. You are curious about them.

gente: La gente aquí es muy amable.

title: At the café
goal: Order something to drink and eat, ask the price, ask for the bill.
scenario: You are a friendly waitress (camarera) at a small café in Sevilla. The learner is the customer. Stay in the role.

pedir: I want to order a coffee.
agua: Un agua sin gas, por favor.
beber: I want to drink something cold.
mesa: Una mesa para dos, por favor.
pan: Could you bring me more bread, please?
leche: Un café con leche, por favor.

title: Your day
goal: Describe a normal day: when you get up, eat, work and what you do in the evening.
scenario: You and the learner are friends chatting about your daily routines.

día: Mi día empieza a las siete.
mañana: In the morning I drink coffee.
tarde: Por la tarde trabajo en casa.
In the afternoon I work at home.
noche: Por la noche veo la tele.
In the evening I watch TV.
hora: What time do you have dinner?
siempre: I always have breakfast at home.
después: Después del trabajo, voy al gimnasio.
After work, I go to the gym.
antes: Leo un poco antes de dormir.
I read a little before bed.
salir: Salgo de casa a las ocho.
volver: Vuelvo a casa a las seis.
I get back home at six.
empezar: Empiezo a trabajar a las nueve.
terminar: Termino de trabajar a las cinco.

title: Family & friends
goal: Talk about the people in your life: family members, friends, what they are like.
scenario: You are showing each other photos on your phones and talking about family and friends.

hijo: My son is five years old.
mayor: Mi hermano mayor vive en Madrid.
My older brother lives in Madrid.
pequeño: Mi hermana pequeña tiene diez años.
My little sister is ten years old.
abuelo: My grandfather is eighty years old.

title: Last weekend
goal: Tell what you did last weekend using the past tense (fui, hice, vi, comí).
scenario: It is Monday morning. You ask the learner about their weekend and share yours.

ir: On Saturday I went to the market.
salir: On Friday I went out with friends.
ayer: Yesterday I had lunch with my family.
película: I saw a really good film.
fiesta: Fui a una fiesta el sábado.
I went to a party on Saturday.
amigo: I had dinner with a friend.
playa: El domingo fui a la playa.
On Sunday I went to the beach.
cine: I went to the cinema on Sunday.

title: Free conversation
goal: Talk about anything you like. Sofía slips in the most common words you haven't learned yet.
scenario: A relaxed chat. Follow the learner's interests and ask about their life.
